name: Ama Imo! Amaenbou de Guutara na Imouto no Ecchi na Yuuwaku
original_name: あま妹！ 甘えん坊でぐーたらな妹のえっちな誘惑
source:
While their parents were away, the protagonist, Itsuki, was asked to look after his younger sister and returned to his family home.
There, he found his sister, Hinano, lounging lazily on the couch as usual, playing video games.

Itsuki scolded his messy sister but still took care of her.
Hinano pouted and whined a little, but she still clung to her older brother, acting spoiled.

Their sibling relationship seemed unchanged.
Nothing out of the ordinary, and the two continued living together peacefully—

"Wait… huh? Were we… always in this kind of relationship…?"

…Or so it should’ve been.

But somehow, a mix of impulse and stubbornness led the two to cross a line they shouldn’t have.

The next day, Itsuki, overwhelmed with guilt, became even more indulgent toward Hinano.
But Hinano, on the other hand, didn’t seem bothered by what had happened at all.
In fact, she smirked as she watched her brother’s flustered behavior.

(…Hmm… if I do that kind of thing with him, will big brother be even nicer to me?)

Her thoughts took a wild leap, and she began clinging to him more intensely—and more suggestively—than ever before.
Itsuki, determined not to let things spiral further, tried to resist.

But will he be able to fend off her temptations and set his lazy sister back on the right path…?

translation:
父母外出期间，主人公树被要求照看妹妹，于是回到了家。

在那里，他发现妹妹日菜乃和往常一样懒洋洋地躺在沙发上玩游戏。

树训斥了邋遢的妹妹，却还是照顾着她。
日菜乃嘟着嘴小声抱怨，但仍然撒娇似的黏着哥哥。

兄妹之间的关系似乎没有改变。
一切都和平常一样，两人继续平静地共同生活——

“等等……咦？我们以前……一直是这种关系吗……？”

……本来应该是这样。

然而，不知为何，冲动与固执交织在一起，让两人跨越了不该跨越的界线。

第二天，树被强烈的罪恶感压垮，对日菜乃变得更加纵容。
但日菜乃似乎完全不在意发生的一切。
事实上，她看着哥哥慌乱的样子，脸上还露出了坏笑。

（……嗯……如果和哥哥做那种事，他会不会对我更好？）

她的思绪肆意飞驰，开始比以往更加紧紧地黏着哥哥，暗示意味也更浓。
树下定决心不能让事态继续失控，试图抵抗她的诱惑。

但他能抵挡妹妹的诱惑，让这个懒散的妹妹重新走上正轨吗……？
